reason: Replace non-proving activation lanes with issue-local inventory, structured-data, link, version, and historical-boundary proof.

acceptance_criteria: Canonical inventory classifies every checked current or historical surface and names its owner and disposition
docs/planning/ADL_FEATURE_LIST.md and current entrypoints identify v0.92 as active without claiming planned features complete
All authoritative current version declarations record an observed version equal to their declared v0.92 or 0.92.0 expectation and Cargo metadata is internally consistent
Historical milestone, release, review, migration, and pre-existing evidence records retain their original version and claims while new .csdlc/evidence/5818 proof remains allowed
Every inventoried current JSON and YAML file parses and every local Markdown link in the declared current boundary resolves
Current AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md, skills, and runbooks agree with final C-SDLC v2 authority
Focused diff, lockfile, placeholder, stale-reference, and exact-revision review checks pass

steps.action: Build and review the classified canonical-surface and version-authority inventory, including expected and observed versions for declarations
Update current documentation, feature inventory, links, and authoritative version metadata without historical drift
Run the issue-local activation validator, locked Cargo metadata, diff hygiene, and exact-revision review

Prove locked workspace/package metadata is internally consistent after authoritative version activation.
